_about: Water (1) + gamma-valerolactone (2): isobaric bubble temperatures (T-x, no vapour compositions in this set) at three pressures, from Havasi et al. (2016). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: liquid mole fraction of water, boiling temperature in K, its expanded uncertainty in K as stored in the record. Used to check the Modified UNIFAC 2.0 prediction (known issue), not fitted.

source.citation: D. Havasi, P. Mizsey, L. T. Mika, Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Study of the Gamma-Valerolactone-Water Binary System, J. Chem. Eng. Data 61 (2016) 1502-1508
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 8 (boiling temperature at pressure P, against pressure and the liquid mole fraction of water). The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: The record's set 7 gives vapour mole fractions against temperature for the same isobars; not used here. The pure-component rows (x_1 = 0 and 1) are kept as stored.
